scope: Offline Editor: two real awakening/navigation captures, real two-second cinematic and crimson barrier, virtual Input System keyboard/mouse, existing mobile input, original CharacterController, health, UI and thirty-second nest sleep. Authorization and death/observer cases use explicitly identified fixtures. Live 2–4-client transport and native Android input/device performance are separate checks. Outcome clicks use raycast-validated Unity EventSystem pointer fixtures because the desktop Editor does not have OS input focus. Native OS mouse/touch input remains unverified.
